ازدجرتا (form VIII)
# اِزْدَجَرَتَا (izdajaratā) /iz.da.d͡ʒa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
# اُزْدُجِرَتَا (uzdujiratā) /uz.du.d͡ʒi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِزْدَجَرَ (izdajara)
